title: Diagnostics
subtitle: Understand mail loading
description: Review loading times and errors for your mailbox. Expand an entry to inspect individual steps.
retention: Up to {{max}} entries per mailbox, automatically cleaned up after {{days}} days. No passwords, tokens, mail contents, subjects, search terms or folder names. Recording starts with this update.
demo: The demo does not log real connections.
empty: No matching entries yet. Open your mailbox, then refresh the log.
stagesHint: Steps may be nested, so their durations should not be added together.
active: Still active when the request ended
noStages: No individual IMAP steps recorded, for example on a cache hit or a browser/proxy failure.
count: {{shown}} of {{total}} matching entries. The download contains all stored entries for this mailbox.
